title: Thai Bean Sprout Casserole
description: A flavorful and nutritious Thai-inspired casserole made with juicy bean sprouts and a blend of savory spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the bean sprouts and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the juicy tomatoes, American cheese, casserole mix, fish sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar.
Stir well to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with additional shredded cheese if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh cilantro.
